description: This file defines the CookieJar class, which manages cookies by providing methods to set, get, pack, and unpack cookies, along with refresh state management. It belongs to the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: A class for managing cookies including their refresh state, serialization, and storage.

methods.name: IsStale
methods.description: Checks if the cookie jar is stale.

methods.name: MarkAsStale
methods.description: Marks the cookie jar as stale.

methods.name: WaitForRefresh
methods.description: Waits for the cookie jar to be refreshed within a given timeout.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Serializes cookies into a payload with version and checksum.

methods.name: Unpack
methods.description: Deserializes cookies from a payload with version and checksum.
